items.title: How does adding entry points compound the odds of a breach?
items.description: Assume every exposed entry point, or door into the system, independently has some fixed probability of hiding an exploitable flaw. Examples include an API route, an upload handler, or a webhook receiver. Drag the number of entry points and the per-entry risk: the model first calculates the chance that none fail, then subtracts that from 100% to estimate the chance that at least one is exploitable.
items.compute: const p = params.riskPerEndpoint / 100; const probAtLeastOne = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, params.numEndpoints); return { probAtLeastOne: Math.round(probAtLeastOne * 1000) / 10 };

outputs.label: P(at least one exploitable entry point)
